draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.89, the 6th-best grade among 259 2021 draftees and 1st of 22 at LB. He went 12th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Myles Jack. Testing standouts: 40-yard dash (100th percentile). Testing concerns: 20-yard shuttle (14th percentile). College production: his final season (2019) ranked 1st in tackles among the 22 LBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 6 pro, currently with the Green Bay Packers (physically unable to perform). 77 career games and 76 starts over 5 completed seasons. Trending down from his peak: 13 AV in 2025 against a career-best 19 in 2022. Strengths in 2025: pressures 48 (98th percentile), approximate value 13 (96th percentile), sacks 12.5 (96th percentile). Versus the typical Year-5 edge rusher who played: 12.5 sacks against a median of 3.5, above the norm.
